spec.subject: Stylized female human tutorial NPC Arin Unreal UE5
spec.description: Stylized female human tutorial NPC Arin for Unreal UE5. 170cm height, 30000 tris budget, 2k texture. Existing closed T-pose 3D mesh generated by the unchanged ApolloHullAdapter from AI-generated front and side silhouettes, with a separate truthful hull-report.json. CPU local_draft prototype, not a production-provider reconstruction. Geometry-only source initially; Blender manual rig and idle are separate later work. Preserve the uploaded geometry and reference appearance; do not overwrite it with procedural PBR textures. Export GLB and FBX.
